preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
Size of arrays A and B is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Elements of array A are integers with absolute value less than or equal to 10^5.
Elements of array B are integers with absolute value less than or equal to 10^5.
Number of operations K is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output should be a single integer representing the maximum value of interaction of the arrays.
